summary: BRC Group Holdings (formerly B. Riley Financial) filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive arrangement agreement, dated September 28, 2026, for its wholly-owned Ontario subsidiary to acquire all outstanding common shares of Sangoma Technologies via a court-approved plan of arrangement. Sangoma shareholders receive US$4.925 cash plus 0.04767 BRC shares per share, with RSUs/PSUs/DSUs cashed out at US$5.225 per underlying share. Both boards approved; no advisor named. BRC relies on Section 3(a)(10) exemption, adding Nasdaq stock consideration and Canadian court timing to an essentially cash-heavy transaction.
